newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares extend gains in slightly lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares extend gains in slightly lower trade.

text.p: 1025 GMT - Polish shares rose for the third session running but trade was lower and selling stronger after price-fixing. * The main market's WIG index rose 86.5 points, or 0.5 percent, to 16,721.4, the WIG 20 rose 0.7 percent to 1,656.1 and the parallel market's WIRR rose 0.7 percent to 3,675.8. * Turnover fell 4.8 percent to 174.9 million zlotys on all three markets as 41 issues rose, 32 fell and 20 were flat. Sell orders for 14 stocks and buy orders for five were not matched. Most active Budimex rose 9.8 percent in a 13.8- million-zloty turnover. NFI units fell 0.7 percent in 12.8-million-zloty trade. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
